title: Spot the kill: every attacker at the 9-life player
briefing: P1 declares attackers with 12 power on board. P3 is at 9 life with one untapped 2/2 that cannot block a flyer. Sending all three creatures at P3 is lethal through any block the 2/2 can make; anything less is not. P4 is wide open at 40 life (the tempting free damage) and P2 holds two large untapped blockers (the trap).

reference.analysis: Colossal Dreadmaw (6/6 trample), Serra Angel (4/4 flying, vigilance) and Kalonian Tusker (3/3) total 13 power. P3 has 9 life and one Grizzly Bears. If the Bears block the Dreadmaw, 4 tramples over and 4 + 4 + 3 = 11. If they block the Tusker, 6 + 4 = 10. They cannot block the Angel. Every block leaves at least 10 damage, so the three-creature attack on P3 always removes a player. Two attackers at P3 are not enough against the right block (Dreadmaw + Angel is 8 after a Dreadmaw block). Attacking P4 is 13 free damage but kills nobody. Attacking P2 runs into a 10/10 and a 4/5.

options.label: All three attack P3 (lethal)
options.why: Guaranteed elimination of P3 through any block.

options.label: Attacks into P2's blockers
options.why: The Tusker dies to a 10/10 or a 4/5 for nothing.

options.label: Dreadmaw into P2's blockers
options.why: The Dreadmaw dies to Gigantosaurus for nothing.

options.label: Dreadmaw and Angel at P3, Tusker elsewhere
options.why: Ten power at P3 kills only if the Bears do not block the Dreadmaw; against the correct block P3 survives at 1. Right target, one attacker short.

options.label: No attack
options.why: Passes up a guaranteed kill and deals no damage at all.

otherwise.why: Deals damage safely but misses the guaranteed elimination of P3.
